entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Sarah Miller. Order number is VF98765.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the VeloFit Aero Jersey, delivered nine days ago. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Okay, I understand. Can you tell me a bit more about the sizing issue?
The jersey is just too tight across the shoulders. It's not going to work.

I'm sorry to hear it wasn't the right fit. The good news is that you are well within our 90-day return window for apparel. We can definitely get this sorted out for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to do an exchange for the next size up?

Excellent. I can process that for you right now. I will send a prepaid return label to the email on file. Just package the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it off. As soon as we receive the tracking scan, we will ship out the new size to you. Does that work?
Alright, I've just sent that email with the return label and all the instructions for the exchange. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sarah?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope the new jersey is a perfect fit. Have a great day.
